def: Eager to learn or know something.
ex: The curious child asked how the clock worked.
arEx: سأل الطفل الفضولي كيف تعمل الساعة.

def: To take something and give it back after using it.
ex: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?

def: A trip from one place to another, especially a long one.
ex: Their journey across the country took five days.
arEx: استغرقت رحلتهم عبر البلاد خمسة أيام.

def: Calm, soft, and careful in the way you act or speak.
ex: She spoke in a gentle voice to calm the puppy.

def: To become better, or to make something better.
ex: Reading every day will improve your vocabulary.

def: A person who lives near you.
ex: Our neighbor waters our plants when we travel.

def: Able to be trusted to do what is expected.
ex: He is a reliable colleague who always meets deadlines.
arEx: هو زميل موثوق يلتزم دائماً بالمواعيد النهائية.

def: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
ex: They negotiated a fair price for the old house.
arEx: تفاوضوا على سعر عادل للمنزل القديم.

def: A particular way of thinking about something.
ex: Travelling gave her a new perspective on her own culture.
arEx: منحها السفر وجهة نظر جديدة عن ثقافتها.

def: A result or effect of an action or decision.
ex: Missing the meeting had serious consequences for the project.
arEx: كان لتفويت الاجتماع عواقب خطيرة على المشروع.

def: Unwilling and hesitant to do something.
ex: She was reluctant to speak in front of the whole class.
arEx: كانت مترددة في التحدث أمام الصف كله.

def: To succeed in doing or completing something.
ex: He accomplished his goal of running a marathon.
arEx: أنجز هدفه في الجري في ماراثون.

def: Lasting for only a very short time.
ex: The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral, fading within days.
arEx: جمال أزهار الكرز زائل ويتلاشى خلال أيام.

def: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
ex: The editor was meticulous, catching every tiny error.
arEx: كان المحرر دقيقاً وكشف كل خطأ صغير.

def: Seeming to be present everywhere at the same time.
ex: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
arEx: أصبحت الهواتف الذكية منتشرة في كل مكان في الحياة العصرية.

def: To make something less harmful, severe, or serious.
ex: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of urban heat.
arEx: يمكن لزراعة الأشجار أن تخفف من آثار حرارة المدن.

def: Dealing with problems in a practical and realistic way.
ex: She took a pragmatic approach and focused on what was achievable.
arEx: اتبعت نهجاً عملياً وركزت على ما يمكن تحقيقه.

def: The pleasant discovery of something good by chance.
ex: Meeting my mentor at the café was pure serendipity.
arEx: كان لقائي بمرشدي في المقهى مصادفة سعيدة بحتة.
